This leaf is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

A Welwal leaf eaten without further preparation removes three rounds of stun. It is exceptionally difficult to find in the hot jungles where it grows. This immediate action distinguishes it from decoctions requiring advance preparation.
